findings.description: Critical: The initial migration contract added NOT NULL fingerprint columns before backfilling ri-01 rows and named the old natural-key constraint incorrectly, so migration 030 could not safely apply over existing registry data.
findings.resolution: Freeze nullable-add, legacy backfill, NOT NULL/check, correctly named constraint replacement, and populated-029 migration tests.

findings.description: Critical: Registry lease checks alone do not fence late writes to a shared isolated table after takeover; a stale worker could corrupt storage after a replacement verifies or marks it ready.
findings.resolution: Use attempt-specific staging tables/manifests and a current-token, attempt-generation checked atomic publish transaction; test a late stale write after replacement publication.

findings.description: Critical: Full rebuild semantics initially implied mutation of a ready ri-01 identity even though ready records are immutable and cannot be reclaimed.
findings.resolution: Limit full rebuild to clean staging for an unready attempt; identical ready requests remain no-op and replacement requires a changed pipeline fingerprint.

findings.description: Critical: The core copy-forward compatibility package could report success when its resource-gated test skipped, leaving the storage strategy unproven.
findings.resolution: Require a deterministic non-skipping target-contract test and freeze the thin fenced storage adapter; keep live Postgres/CocoIndex as classified integration evidence.

findings.description: Critical: The initial database contract omitted the physical chunk table, per-file ownership, copy, retry, verification, and publication behavior required by the selected architecture.
findings.resolution: Add final/attempt naming, row shape, path-aware identity, per-file transaction, HNSW, copy rules, verification, and fenced publish to the storage contract and target strategy.

findings.description: Critical: The initial package DAG scheduled concrete embedding configuration after the CocoIndex adapter that needed the provider protocol.
findings.resolution: Add an independent early embedding-protocol package consumed by both the adapter and downstream concrete provider configuration.

findings.description: Critical: Secret scanning and gitignore semantics lacked a pinned local protocol, timeout/error behavior, dependency scope, and sanitized evidence contract.
findings.resolution: Define a bounded built-in local-only scanner that fails the operation closed, add matcher dependency scope, and give tests/modules to the source-policy package.

findings.description: Critical: A wholly absent embedding model/dimension could not produce the natural key required for the proposed durable not-configured result.
findings.resolution: Distinguish ephemeral preflight not-configured for an absent contract from durable not-configured for a declared contract whose package, credential, or endpoint is unavailable.

findings.description: Critical: Arbitrary indexing parameters could serialize secrets and make embedder fingerprints nondeterministic.
findings.resolution: Whitelist supported non-secret parameters, constrain credential references, define canonical JSON hashing, and reject secret-like or noncanonical values.

findings.description: Critical: Extending the strict ri-01 record in prose contradicted its additionalProperties false v1 schema.
findings.resolution: Publish an explicit strict v2 record schema, preserve v1 legacy decoding, and require ri-03 to consume v2 while excluding legacy sentinel rows.

findings.description: Critical: The initial execution-result schema admitted impossible ready/non-durable, promoted/non-main, reused/non-ready, and partial-parent combinations.
findings.resolution: Add conditional invariants for durability, identity, readiness, promotion, reuse, and parent id/revision pairing plus negative schema tests.

findings.description: Critical: Parent linkage and retry behavior initially depended only on application convention and did not prevent self/incompatible parents or explain partial-attempt repair.
findings.resolution: Guard parent compatibility/immutability in persistence, verify Git ancestry in application code, and use clean generation-specific retry staging with failure-injection tests.

findings.description: Nit: Final package verification initially omitted explicit work-package, static-analysis, architecture, and live-evidence classification gates promised by task prose.
findings.resolution: Add explicit result-keyed verification steps and require reports to distinguish live passage from environment deferral.

findings.description: Positive: Copy-forward from a compatible ready Git ancestor preserves immutable revision storage while making changed-file embedding directly measurable.
